plugin.name: Apache Maven GPG Plugin
plugin.description: Signs the project artifacts with GnuPG.

mojo.description: Sign project artifact, the POM, and attached artifacts with GnuPG for deployment.

parameter.name: ascDirectory
parameter.description: The directory where to store signature files.

parameter.name: defaultKeyring
parameter.description: Whether to add the default keyrings from gpg's home directory to the list of used keyrings.

parameter.name: excludes
parameter.description: A list of files to exclude from being signed. Can contain Ant-style wildcards and double wildcards. The default excludes are **/*.md5 **/*.sha1 **/*.asc.

parameter.name: executable
parameter.description: The path to the GnuPG executable to use for artifact signing. Defaults to either "gpg" or "gpg.exe" depending on the operating system.

parameter.name: gpgArguments
homedir
parameter.description: The directory from which gpg will load keyrings. If not specified, gpg will use the value configured for its installation, e.g. ~/.gnupg or %APPDATA%/gnupg.

parameter.name: keyname
parameter.description: The "name" of the key to sign with. Passed to gpg as --local-user.

parameter.name: lockMode
passphrase
parameter.description: The passphrase to use when signing.

parameter.name: publicKeyring
parameter.description: The path to a public keyring to add to the list of keyrings. By default, only the {@code pubring.gpg} from gpg's home directory is considered. Use this option (and {@link #defaultKeyring} if required) to use a different public key. Note: Relative paths are resolved against gpg's home directory, not the project base directory.

parameter.name: secretKeyring
parameter.description: The path to a secret keyring to add to the list of keyrings. By default, only the {@code secring.gpg} from gpg's home directory is considered. Use this option (in combination with {@link #publicKeyring} and {@link #defaultKeyring} if required) to use a different secret key. Note: Relative paths are resolved against gpg's home directory, not the project base directory.

parameter.name: skip
parameter.description: Skip doing the gpg signing.

parameter.name: useAgent
parameter.description: Passes --use-agent or --no-use-agent to gpg. If using an agent, the passphrase is optional as the agent will provide it. For gpg2, specify true as --no-use-agent was removed in gpg2 and doesn't ask for a passphrase anymore.

mojo.description: Signs artifacts and installs the artifact in the remote repository.

parameter.name: artifactId
parameter.description: ArtifactId of the artifact to be deployed. Retrieved from POM file if specified.

parameter.name: ascDirectory
parameter.description: The directory where to store signature files.

parameter.name: classifier
parameter.description: Add classifier to the artifact

parameter.name: classifiers
parameter.description: A comma separated list of classifiers for each of the extra side artifacts to deploy. If there is a mis-match in the number of entries in {@link #files} or {@link #types}, then an error will be raised.

parameter.name: defaultKeyring
parameter.description: Whether to add the default keyrings from gpg's home directory to the list of used keyrings.

parameter.name: description
parameter.description: Description passed to a generated POM file (in case of generatePom=true).

parameter.name: executable
parameter.description: The path to the GnuPG executable to use for artifact signing. Defaults to either "gpg" or "gpg.exe" depending on the operating system.

parameter.name: file
parameter.description: File to be deployed.

parameter.name: files
parameter.description: A comma separated list of files for each of the extra side artifacts to deploy. If there is a mis-match in the number of entries in {@link #types} or {@link #classifiers}, then an error will be raised.

parameter.name: generatePom
parameter.description: Upload a POM for this artifact. Will generate a default POM if none is supplied with the pomFile argument.

parameter.name: gpgArguments
groupId
parameter.description: GroupId of the artifact to be deployed. Retrieved from POM file if specified.

parameter.name: homedir
parameter.description: The directory from which gpg will load keyrings. If not specified, gpg will use the value configured for its installation, e.g. ~/.gnupg or %APPDATA%/gnupg.

parameter.name: javadoc
parameter.description: The bundled API docs for the artifact.

parameter.name: keyname
parameter.description: The "name" of the key to sign with. Passed to gpg as --local-user.

parameter.name: lockMode
offline
parameter.description: Flag whether Maven is currently in online/offline mode.

parameter.name: packaging
parameter.description: Type of the artifact to be deployed. Retrieved from POM file if specified. Defaults to file extension if not specified via command line or POM.

parameter.name: passphrase
parameter.description: The passphrase to use when signing.

parameter.name: pomFile
parameter.description: Location of an existing POM file to be deployed alongside the main artifact, given by the ${file} parameter.

parameter.name: publicKeyring
parameter.description: The path to a public keyring to add to the list of keyrings. By default, only the {@code pubring.gpg} from gpg's home directory is considered. Use this option (and {@link #defaultKeyring} if required) to use a different public key. Note: Relative paths are resolved against gpg's home directory, not the project base directory.

parameter.name: repositoryId
parameter.description: Server Id to map on the <id> under <server> section of settings.xml. In most cases, this parameter will be required for authentication.

parameter.name: repositoryLayout
parameter.description: The type of remote repository layout to deploy to. Try legacy for a Maven 1.x-style repository layout.

parameter.name: retryFailedDeploymentCount
parameter.description: Parameter used to control how many times a failed deployment will be retried before giving up and failing. If a value outside the range 1-10 is specified it will be pulled to the nearest value within the range 1-10.

parameter.name: secretKeyring
parameter.description: The path to a secret keyring to add to the list of keyrings. By default, only the {@code secring.gpg} from gpg's home directory is considered. Use this option (in combination with {@link #publicKeyring} and {@link #defaultKeyring} if required) to use a different secret key. Note: Relative paths are resolved against gpg's home directory, not the project base directory.

parameter.name: sources
parameter.description: The bundled sources for the artifact.

parameter.name: types
parameter.description: A comma separated list of types for each of the extra side artifacts to deploy. If there is a mis-match in the number of entries in {@link #files} or {@link #classifiers}, then an error will be raised.

parameter.name: uniqueVersion
parameter.description: Whether to deploy snapshots with a unique version or not.

parameter.name: updateReleaseInfo
parameter.description: Parameter used to update the metadata to make the artifact as release.

parameter.name: url
parameter.description:
URL where the artifact will be deployed.
ie ( file:///C:/m2-repo or scp://host.com/path/to/repo )

parameter.name: useAgent
parameter.description: Passes --use-agent or --no-use-agent to gpg. If using an agent, the passphrase is optional as the agent will provide it. For gpg2, specify true as --no-use-agent was removed in gpg2 and doesn't ask for a passphrase anymore.

parameter.name: version
parameter.description: Version of the artifact to be deployed. Retrieved from POM file if specified.

mojo.description:
Display help information on maven-gpg-plugin.
Call mvn gpg:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

parameter.name: detail
parameter.description: If true, display all settable properties for each goal.

parameter.name: goal
parameter.description: The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.

parameter.name: indentSize
parameter.description: The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.

parameter.name: lineLength
parameter.description: The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.
